name: Summoning the Princess
summary: Theldurin the Lost says Myzrael must be beaten while she is still growing, before her strength is enough to challenge those who hold her captive. At the Shards of Myzrael you call her forth, defeat her, and bind her Eldritch Shackles to the Shards.

sections.title: Why She Must Be Stopped
sections.body: Theldurin wants Myzrael stopped before her power swells enough to set her against her captors. Some claim she can be controlled; Theldurin asks why, then, the giants bothered to chain her at all.

sections.title: At the Shards
sections.body: You take the Scroll of Myzrael to the Shards, the place where you first talked with her, and call her up. After you defeat her, her Eldritch Shackles are yours to bind to the Shards, and she is trapped once more.

sections.title: When the Shackles Are Placed
sections.body: As the shackles settle around the Shards, a wail rises from far below, followed by a roar. The warmth and sense of safety the Shards once gave is gone. Now they pulse with open menace, as though the thing beneath them bears the surface ill will.

faq.q: Who sends you to fight Myzrael?
faq.answer: Theldurin the Lost, who warns that Myzrael must be beaten before her strength grows enough to challenge her captors.

faq.q: Where does the summoning take place?
faq.answer: At the Shards of Myzrael, the place where you first talked with her.

faq.q: Why does Theldurin want Myzrael defeated?
faq.answer: Theldurin fears she will grow strong enough to challenge her captors. Theldurin also points out that if she could truly be controlled, the giants would not have chained her.
With the Scroll of Myzrael, used at the Shards of Myzrael.

faq.q: What do you do with the Eldritch Shackles?
faq.answer: Defeat Myzrael, take her shackles, and fasten them to the Shards. Then she is trapped again.
